subject: Anchor shift notice — MAP update and acceptance conditions
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica@helios.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Anchor shift notice — MAP update and acceptance conditions

Jessica / Helios team,

Thanks for the heads-up this morning. Per our call, I logged the procurement lag and attached a cleaned-up MAP (Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf) plus an acceptance matrix that maps each eval gate to a required artifact. Key points / asks: 

- What changed: Helios procurement needs an additional 3 weeks for PO approvals; target close date slides from 2026-06-25 to 2026-07-16 unless we can surface an interim commitment.
- Options we can offer quickly: 1) Partial canary (pilot) agreement to start eval work and telemetry sharing; 2) Short-term commercial hold + guaranteed go/no-go on 2026-07-02; 3) Maintain original acceptance gates but accept delayed final PO with a revised SLA.
- Immediate ask: Jessica, can procurement provide written confirmation of the new internal milestone and the anticipated PO issuance week? A one-paragraph email is sufficient for our exec calendar.

Marissa, Jonas — I need a consolidated risk digest by EOD with proposed mitigations tied to each option above (e.g., reduce eval window from 10 to 5 business days; commit a dedicated engineer during pilot). Priyom, please prep a short cost-impact note for the revised timeline so we can discuss discounting/credit implications with Finance.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP with updated milestones), acceptance_matrix_helios.xlsx (gate -> artifact mapping).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Jessica Park <jessica@helios.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helios.com
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Anchor shift notice — MAP update and acceptance conditions

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the summary. Confirming: Procurement has hit an approver backlog tied to our Q3 budget reconciliation — we're estimating PO out the week of 06/29, not 06/18. I can send a one-line confirmation by EOD to the team (will include the internal milestone owners).

Regarding options, Helios prefers option 1 (partial canary) if Redwood can scope a lightweight pilot that produces usable metrics for our security and performance gates. We will need clear work ownership and a short commitment window (2 weeks).

I should note legal wants standard indemnity language included in any pilot paperwork; they asked us to flag that up front.

Jessica
Jessica Park
Director, Cloud Ops | Helios Systems
jessica@helios.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Anchor shift notice — MAP update and acceptance conditions

Kimberly / team —

Putting together the risk digest and mitigations below (high-level):

1) Risk: Procurement slide -> delayed PO. Impact: push to final acceptance, revenue recognition delay, potential resource contention in July.
   Mitigation: Offer pilot SOW (two-week canary) limited to 10k tokens/day, Redwood provides a dedicated SRE for onboarding and telemetry. Pilot acceptance criteria: successful end-to-end inference on Helios sample workload and telemetry exported to Helios SIEM.

2) Risk: Legal language blocking pilot (indemnity ask). Impact: pilot scope decreased or delayed.
   Mitigation: Use a two-way mutual NDA + one-off pilot addendum with limited indemnity exposure; ops to involve Legal for a 48-hour turnaround on the addendum template (I will ping Legal).

3) Risk: Eval gating compression degrades signal. Impact: poor decision basis at final acceptance.
   Mitigation: Prioritize gating on availability and tail-latency metrics; reduce eval window but increase synthetic load variety. Capture baseline metrics during the first 24 hours.

Action items by EOD: 
- Marissa: Draft pilot addendum template and short risk digest (will attach).
- Priyom: Cost-impact note for pilot vs. full rollout (include credit scenarios).
- Jonas: Confirm exec-level approval threshold if procurement slips past 06/29.

Quoting Jessica below for context:

>
> Thanks for the summary. Confirming: Procurement has hit an approver backlog tied to our Q3 budget reconciliation — we're estimating PO out the week of 06/29, not 06/18. I can send a one-line confirmation by EOD to the team (will include the internal milestone owners).
>
> Regarding options, Helios prefers option 1 (partial canary) if Redwood can scope a lightweight pilot that produces usable metrics for our security and performance gates.

Marissa

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 17:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Anchor shift notice — MAP update and acceptance conditions

Team —

Good summary. I endorse the pilot approach as the primary de-risk path but want firm dates and exec visibility if PO slips beyond 06/29. Proposed plan: 

1) Pilot kickoff: week of 06/15 (if Helios can sign the pilot addendum). Pilot scope = 2 weeks, SRE + one engineer from Redwood, limited token budget. Deliverable: telemetry snapshot + short readout.
2) Contingency timeline: if procurement confirmation is documented and dated for week of 06/29, we roll pilot -> acceptance window starting 07/06 and final acceptance target 07/16.
3) Escalation: If Helios cannot provide procurement confirmation by 06/25, we escalate to Markus for exec outreach and consider a short commercial credit to hold close until 07/16.

Priyom — please model 2 scenarios (pilot-only revenue impact; full close with 2-week credit) and share with Finance. Marissa — loop Legal for the addendum and aim for a 48-hour sign-off cadence. Kimberly — ask Helios for the one-line PO milestone ASAP and copy Markus so execs have visibility.

I have attached procurement_confirm_template.docx to expedite procurement's note. Also updating HubSpot (link below) with the new timeline so we can track alerts.

Jonas Weber
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
